english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for leading or directing people or tasks.

exampleSentences.english: I conduct the whole team as we complete this task.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我帶住成隊人完成呢項任務。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 daai3 zyu6 seng4 deoi6 jan4 jyun4 sing4 ni1 hong6 jam6 mou6

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for taking or guiding someone somewhere, guiding them toward an answer, leading a group, or describing a route that takes you somewhere.

exampleSentences.english: Please lead me to the MTR station.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 laa1
